text:
maya: Quick capture from vendor triage. Need a compact onramp plan: GA windows, marketplace gating, SI rebuilds, and fallback routing.
oliver: TL;DR: H100 microcode still in soak; H200 stable but vendor suggested firmware pin; MI300 APAC sign-off pending; Gaudi driver introduces a minor ABI change.
zara: marketplace constraint reminder: we must have final image sha256 + driver id at least 9 calendar days before any public listing. Also marketing needs 8bd for embargo.
kevin-pm: product ask: Can we create a "partner preview" lane that bypasses public PR but still surfaces SKUs to select partners for testing? That buys time.
suresh: SI note: Gaudi ABI delta requires rebuild. Expect ~48h per integrator to run the CI rebuild and smoke tests. Suggest we pre-generate automated rebuild jobs on RC publish.
vendor-feed-bot: Vendor update: H100 microcode soak extended +10 days; Gaudi driver RC published, pending ABI notes; MI300 APAC compliance docs awaiting signatures. (link: https://vendor.example/notice/3778)
maya: proposal: two-track rollout:
- partner-preview (pinned hashes, limited access) -> immediate once images validated
- public announce -> after vendor GA + e2e pass and legal sign-off
oliver: fallback mapping for routing if H100 validation not complete: prefer h200-prod then b200-q8 for latency-critical routes. Example policy: `routePolicy.set('h100_fallback', ['h200-prod','b200-q8']).when(microcode_unverified || p99>180)`
zara: marketing: partner-preview ok, but messaging must include "pending vendor validation" clause. Also need a one-paragraph fallback blurb.
kevin-pm: owners and deadlines:
- maya: consolidate vendor attestation & timeline (due 2024-07-16)
- zara: draft partner-preview gating doc + embargos (due 2024-07-14)
- suresh: CI rebuild automation + dry-run slots (reserve 2024-07-18..19)
- oliver: routing config + infra ticket for temporary B200 capacity (open INF-9309)
suresh: I'll post the CI job template and list of integrator leads. If RC lands, automated rebuild should run within 2 hours. Need integrator emails to pre-authorize.
zara: legal note: include clause: "Performance claims are contingent on vendor driver/firmware final validation; public numbers subject to change." Legal has a short approved snippet.
vendor-feed-bot: Reminder: vendor security portal updated; check CVE feed before publish.
maya: risk log snippet:
- Risk: H100 microcode delay -> Impact: postpone public announce; Mitigation: partner-preview + fallback routing + soft-list in marketplace.
kevin-pm: timing check: if vendor GA slips past 2024-08-08, we keep partner-preview live and delay public press. Marketing embargo calendar shifts accordingly.
oliver: infra ops: reassign Dedicated node tags to B200 if rollback triggered; planning window ~36h to reprovision. I'll open ticket and tag oncall.
suresh: SI dry-run plan: mirror infra, run smoke + perf sanity (p99, token-drop), escalate if >1% token-loss. Post results in this thread.
zara: I'll prepare partner invites and pinned-hash list. Also drafting fallback messaging now.
maya: final: I'll update partners drive with consolidated timeline and owners, and ping vendor PMs for attestation. Will re-open thread after vendor confirms. :thumbsup:
